component.name: Tunneler Online
component.summary: The 1991 tunnel-digging tank duel, with online play

description.p: TUNNELER 2.0 (1991, Geoffrey Silverton) rewritten from its decompiled source: two tanks dig through an underground world, each seeing only a small window around itself, hunting each other with cannon fire while energy and shields run down. It plays exactly like the original DOS game - the same movement, digging, explosions, sound and look.

ul.li: Split screen for two players on one keyboard or two gamepads, like the original
Skirmish: you against 1 to 7 computer tanks (easy, medium, hard), free-for-all or in teams
Online games with up to 8 tanks: a list of games, lobbies with seats, teams and chat, spectators
Game modes: gold rush, infection, survival, king of the hill, shrinking world, capture the flag, base siege, deathmatch
Line of sight: see only around your tank, or only what dirt and rock don't hide
Small, medium and large maps, rounds to win, a round time limit, friendly fire
English, Slovak, Czech, Ukrainian, Russian and Gen Z slang

description.p: Line of sight (circle or true, with a gray memory of what you have seen), computer tanks that see the same way, short skirmish links, smooth scrolling on by default.
